artifact_inventory.method: Inert ELF/Bun file-table extraction with bounds checks and content hashes. Separate complete Acorn syntax pass, lexical/AST candidate mapping, focused definition/dependency review and actual component/CLI tests.
artifact_inventory.limitation: Syntax and inventory completeness do not establish semantic coverage of every path or a native engine audit.

review.finding: All 44 roles and 78 role/test bindings were migrated. Candidate similarity was not used as approval. Public facade exports and ambiguous definitions were resolved manually, then validated through the component and CLI contracts.

The upstream event producer carries a principal stamp; synchronous and asynchronous exports must remain distinct. The original initializer uses a lightweight logger and the original exporter posts through Bun.FetchSession. Existing early producer/initializer controls remain effective. No production network or privacy-control code was changed.
review.fixture_change: The old HTTP-only receiver could not validate the new HTTPS exporter path. An isolated saved feature value routes the original batch exporter to a loopback HTTP receiver. The test checks three direct event requests, seeded old-queue replay, and a newly emitted explicit event. Standard mode receives exactly one explicit event; optional-off receives zero. The async void contract is asserted. Original exporter and transport execute without a transport mock.
initial_fixture_findings: The public build compiles internal feature-override environment support out, so that variable cannot route this fixture.
maxAttempts counts all attempts; the fixture uses one, not zero.
review.limitation: FetchSession does not use the generic fetch replacement. The known event path is covered by earlier controls; generic fetch/HTTP/HTTP2 tests are not evidence of a universal native transport block.

review.finding: OTel emission adds an idle/unwatched fast return before enrichment. Datadog emission adds egress-refusal and resolver checks. Feedback attaches request identifiers to failure results. Existing producer/initializer replacements and return contracts remain valid in the exercised components.

review.area: business requests, settings and proxy selection
review.finding: The custom-header helper adds an optional x-cowork-enrollment value from host launch options; it is preserved. The reviewed main fetch-options helper retains proxy selection and NO_PROXY handling. Tool timing, gateway hints, functional feature gates, permission decisions and settings application remain upstream. Nine real CLI request cases and six late settings reload cases pass.

The JavaScript search found no literal SO_BINDTODEVICE, protectFromVpn, bindProcessToNetwork, bindSocketToNetwork, setNetworkForProcess, /dev/net/tun or netd_client reference. The ip route occurrence is a read-only WSL IDE-host lookup. The no-route/VPN error remains an errno formatter.
review.limitation: String searches do not exclude numeric syscalls, dynamically constructed names, native helpers or untriggered paths. No actual TUN packet capture or OS policy verification was performed.

acceptance.source_identity: Adapter 1.7.9 production profile and updated component tests; subsequent packaging changes only documentation, source manifest and a test comment.

preserved: Native execution and Android DNS architecture
Policy revision 7 and settings reload protection
Existing profiles, including the component-validated 2.1.310 profile
Official tool timing, gateway hints, shared feature gates and business metadata
Release signing, transactional installation, process leases and cleanup policy
limitations: Isolated configurations, synthetic data, fake credentials and local receivers; no real account login or paid model calls.
Remote Control, real screen-reader hardware, font rendering and long sessions were not validated.
Only the baseline 2.1.310 component suite was rerun; older binary profiles were retained unchanged.
Known optional controls do not prove zero transmission, server-side privacy, account risk scoring or exhaustive native-path coverage.
